note_en: 不管……都…… means "no matter..." or "whether... or...": 不管是猪肉白菜，还是韭菜鸡蛋，都可以根据个人口味自由搭配 "whether it's pork and cabbage or chives and egg, you can mix and match to taste." The second half needs 都 ("in every case") before the verb; English has no equivalent word, so learners often forget it. Notice also that the options are joined with 还是, the "or" of questions and alternatives.
